skill_name: Compare and contrast the data architectures of Apache Cassandra and Apache HBase.
workflow:
Apache Cassandra and Apache HBase are two popular open source data architectures. Both have similar data models, allowing them to store data in a way that is scalable and highly available, but they have some key differences as well.

Apache Cassandra is a distributed NoSQL storage system that uses a masterless “ring” architecture, which allows many nodes to participate in the same cluster. It offers linear scalability, meaning a cluster can scale both in terms of size and throughput as needed. I
